definition: Mathematics and artificial intelligence (AI) have been interrelated since the initial development of AI.
details: On one hand, mathematics plays a key role in artificial intelligence. For example, many AI algorithms use methods relying on optimization, statistics and linear algebra. On the other hand, researchers have for decades been trying to use AI and computers to help solve mathematics problems. The impact of AI has been pronounced in mathematics, where results are exactly verifiable.

explainer.lead: This term names the same two-way relationship: AI algorithms are built on optimisation, statistics and linear algebra, and AI is increasingly used to help solve mathematics problems. Its impact on mathematics is pronounced because results there are exactly verifiable.

tiers.eli5: The maths behind AI, and the use of AI to do maths — each side helps the other.
tiers.practitioner: Practitioners lean on mathematical methods for the algorithms themselves and use AI as a tool for mathematical work. The pitfall is overclaiming AI's impact where results cannot be checked exactly.
tiers.paperLevel: Interrelation since the initial development of AI: mathematical methods (optimisation, statistics, linear algebra) underpin AI algorithms, while AI and computers are used to solve mathematics problems.

explainer.example: A team applies linear algebra and optimisation to train a model, then uses the same model to suggest conjectures that humans verify.
